categories.label: Media Players

packages.name: LibreWolf
packages.summary: Independent privacy-focused fork of Firefox with built-in ad-blocking.
packages.description: The LibreWolf project is a custom and independent version of Firefox, with the primary goals of privacy, security and user freedom.
highlights: Built-in uBlock Origin ad-blocker
Configured with privacy and security in mind
Free and Open Source Software

packages.name: Mozilla Firefox
packages.summary: Cross-platform free and open-source web browser powered by Gecko.
packages.description: Mozilla Firefox is a cross-platform free & open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation. It uses the Gecko rendering engine to display web pages with modern web standards.
highlights: Free and Open Source Software
Extensive add-on ecosystem and hardware acceleration

packages.name: Brave Browser
packages.summary: Chromium-based browser with built-in shields, ad-blocking, and Tor support.
packages.description: Brave Web Browser is based on Chromium and includes performance, privacy, and security enhancement features out of the box.
highlights: Built-in ad-blocker, tracker shields, and Tor private windows
Open Source Software

packages.name: Chromium
packages.summary: Open-source web browser using the fast Blink rendering engine.
packages.description: Chromium is the open-source web browser project that forms the basis for Chrome, Brave, and Vivaldi, using the fast Blink engine without proprietary Google tracking.
highlights: Chrome compatibility without proprietary telemetry
Free and Open Source Software

packages.name: VLC Media Player
packages.summary: Versatile multimedia player that plays almost any audio or video format.
packages.description: VLC is a free and open-source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most multimedia files as well as DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs, and network streams.
highlights: Plays virtually all codecs without extra packs
Free and Open Source Software

packages.name: MPV Media Player
packages.summary: Minimalist, keyboard-driven media player with hardware-accelerated HDR playback.
packages.description: mpv is a free media player for the command line and desktop. It supports a wide variety of media file formats, audio and video codecs, and subtitle types.
highlights: Hardware-accelerated video decoding with HDR support
Minimalist UI and powerful Lua/JS scripting capabilities

packages.name: ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors
packages.summary: Modern tabbed office suite with high Microsoft Office format compatibility.
packages.description: Create, view, and edit text documents, spreadsheets, and presentations of any size and complexity. Work on DOCX, ODT, XLSX, ODS, CSV, PPTX, and ODP within a single tabbed window.
highlights: High fidelity with Microsoft Office document formats
Free and Open Source Software

packages.name: LibreOffice
packages.summary: Full-featured open-source office productivity suite for Linux.
packages.description: LibreOffice is a powerful office suite supporting word processing (Writer), spreadsheets (Calc), presentations (Impress), vector graphics (Draw), databases (Base), and math formulas.
highlights: Complete free and open-source office suite
Native ODF support and wide format compatibility

packages.name: StratMacs (GNU Emacs for StratOS)
packages.summary: Preconfigured GNU Emacs spin tailored for StratOS workflows.
packages.description: StratMacs is a powerful spin of GNU Emacs built with curated plugins and extensions that enhance your development workflow with tight StratOS integration.
highlights: Easier for beginners to learn and use than Vim
Free and Open Source Software

packages.name: StratVIM (NeoVim for StratOS)
packages.summary: Community-curated NeoVim configuration for rapid terminal development.
packages.description: StratVIM is a powerful spin of NeoVim preloaded with LSP, syntax highlighting, and productivity extensions for developers on StratOS.
highlights: Modal editing for high-speed keyboard productivity
Free and Open Source Software

packages.name: VSCodium
packages.summary: Community-driven, telemetry-free binary distribution of VS Code.
packages.description: VSCodium provides everything developers need from Microsoft VS Code, compiled from source without Microsoft branding, telemetry, or tracking.
highlights: Vast extension ecosystem for every programming language
Built-in terminal, Git integration, and debugger

packages.name: Evince PDF Document Viewer
packages.summary: Official GNOME document viewer for PDF, PostScript, DjVu, and TIFF.
packages.description: Evince lets you view, search, and annotate documents across multiple formats with clean desktop integration.
highlights: Supports PDF, PostScript, DjVu, TIFF, DVI, XPS, and SyncTeX
Fast, clean interface

packages.name: Atril PDF Viewer
packages.summary: Lightweight multi-page document viewer maintained by the MATE team.
packages.description: Atril is a fast, low-resource fork of Evince supporting PDF, PostScript, DjVu, DVI, and XPS documents.
highlights: Lightweight and fast startup
Supports PDF, PostScript, DjVu, DVI, and XPS

packages.name: GitHub Desktop
packages.summary: Graphical Git client for managing branches, commits, and pull requests.
packages.description: GitHub Desktop is a GUI application that helps developers interact with GitHub and Git repositories without needing the command line.
highlights: Visual diff viewer, branch management, and PR workflows
Open Source Software (Linux fork maintained by shiftkey)

packages.name: Obsidian
packages.summary: Markdown knowledge base with bidirectional linking and graph visualization.
packages.description: Obsidian works on top of a local folder of plain-text Markdown files, enabling frictionless note-taking, backlinks, and interactive graph exploration.
highlights: Supports CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown, LaTeX, and Mermaid
Local-first plain-text storage

packages.name: GSConnect
packages.summary: KDE Connect implementation for GNOME to sync phones and desktops.
packages.description: GSConnect connects your Linux computer to Android, iOS, or other computers on the same network to share files, clipboard, notifications, and remote control.
highlights: Seamless wireless file transfer and notification sync
Free and Open Source Software
